node.statement: Projection induced by the ideal unit. Since q=q^dagger=q^2 and ||q||=1 in the exact C*-algebra B, def-extended-delta-inclusion gives P^dagger=v(q^dagger)=P, ||P^2-P||=||v(q)v(q)-v(q^2)||<=alpha, and 1-alpha<=||P||<=1+alpha. Thus P is an alpha-projection by def-delta-projection and is nonvanishing for small e because its norm lies in the second alternative with abs(||P||-1)<=alpha<=e.
